L'intégration de l'intelligence artifici: The integration of generative artificial intelligence into open source development is transforming working methods. According to a study by the Linux Foundation, this technology enables productivity gains of up to 50% across all tasks. However, this efficiency comes with a significant increase in low-value-added code change proposals, described as "AI slop".
Les responsables de projets font face à: Project maintainers are facing an increased workload due to these submissions. While 59% of maintainers observe an increase in contributions, they estimate that on average 25% of these proposals are of poor quality. This phenomenon increases with the scale of projects, reaching 31% for the largest ones.
La gestion de ces flux de code généré pa: Managing these flows of AI-generated code poses governance issues. Currently, only 35% of projects have a formal policy regulating the use of AI, while 32% have no plans for one. This situation impacts trust within communities, with 53% of leaders believing that AI has not improved internal cohesion.
Par ailleurs, le rôle du mentorat humain: Furthermore, the role of human mentoring remains crucial. Nearly 46% of project leaders consider that generative AI reinforces the need for guidance for new contributors. Although 61% of contributors perform functional tests on the generated code, transparency regarding the use of these tools remains uneven, complicating the task for maintainers.
